annotations.title: ToolRoute: Register a tool set for routing

description:
Register a tool list once and get a set_id for route_tools. Pass "tools" (array in MCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Bedrock form, max 500) or "url" (public remote MCP server; its tools are listed, never called). Same tools always get the same set_id; sets are kept 90 days after last use. Free.
Not for: picking a tool once from a short list; just pass the tools to your model.

[ToolRoute via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as ToolRoute's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Free.

tools.description: Tool definitions (MCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Bedrock form), max 500. For route: only if you have no set_id (the set is registered on the fly).

items.description: A tool definition: name, description and inputSchema (MCP tools/list or OpenAI/Anthropic shape).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the tool input.

url.description: Register: public remote MCP server URL (https). Tools are listed, never called.
